# Entraiot Solutions

> Entraiot Solutions (Entraiot Solutions Private Limited) is a Chennai, India based IoT and AI solutions company. It delivers end-to-end IoT deployment, real-time dashboards, predictive maintenance, secure network integration, RFID/NFC solutions and custom application development for industries across India.

## Company facts
- Name: Entraiot Solutions Private Limited
- Website: https://entraiot.com
- Location: W-126, 3rd Floor, 3rd Ave, Anna Nagar, Chennai, Tamil Nadu 600040, India
- Service area: Chennai, Tamil Nadu and all of India
- Founder & CEO: Salvin Jones
- Email: bde@entraiot.com
- Phone: +91 99444 42061, +91 81245 45524
- Business hours: Monday to Friday, 09:00-18:00 IST

## Services
- End-to-End IoT Deployment: sensor integration to cloud analytics
- Real-Time Dashboards: instant insight from connected devices
- Predictive Maintenance: AI that forecasts equipment issues before they happen
- Secure Network Integration: encrypted, protected data flow across IoT nodes
- Application Development: custom apps powered by IoT and AI
- Custom UI/UX Interfaces for IoT devices

## Industries served
Logistics, Manufacturing, Hospitality, Energy Management, Smart Cities, Healthcare, Smart Retail, Agriculture.
